component.name: VenTapes
component.summary: Unofficial personal learning fork of Mixtapes

description.p: VenTapes is a private learning experiment based on Mixtapes, a GTK4 and Libadwaita YouTube Music player by Mohamad Obeid and its contributors. It exists to study, modify, break, and learn from the inherited code.
This is not an official release and is not intended for public use, distribution, support, or dependable everyday operation. Use the upstream Mixtapes project for a supported application.
VenTapes is unaffiliated with and not endorsed by the Mixtapes maintainers, YouTube, or Google.
